empty_acl_darwin_test.go: ADR0340 existing access controls preserve-or-refuse, including semantically unchanged no-op. Local Darwin SDK sys/attr.h defines attribute bitmap0x00400000 and attrreference; sys/kauth.h defines filesec magic0x012cc16d, 44-byte no-ACE header, count0 valid empty ACL versus KAUTH_FILESEC_NOACL(-1) absence, and preserving private flags. Native fgetattrlist/fsetattrlist test uses only owned sandbox regular file; first verifies no-ACL to explicit-zero-entry transition. Non-Darwin excludes the _darwin_test.go file; unsupported native errno ENOTSUP/ENOSYS permits an evidence-specific skip, whereas invalid encoding or a supported API failing to establish distinct presence fails. After no-op, exact bytes/inode/mode/filesec remain; changed save must preserve all held filesec bytes with expected literal new payload and replacement inode, or refuse guide.commit with original bytes/inode/mode/filesec. No product filesystem hook or inferred ACL presence from ls entry count is used.

inherited-ACL-publication-cases: ADR0340 preserving existing access controls and publishing private mode0600 temporaries cannot silently add inherited everyone-read grants. Owned fixture parent receives everyone allow read,file_inherit,directory_inherit; only owned selected preparation has its ACL removed with chmod -N. Native fgetattrlist confirms parent permit/file-inherit/read-data bits, selected absence, and a separate owned mode0600 control file actually inheriting permit/inherited/read-data before removal. Existing no-op must retain ACL absence/inode/bytes. Changed existing publication must preserve absent ACL and exact literal named payload or guide.commit refuse without changing any selected bytes/path. Parent ACL remains untouched; directory/file snapshots forbid leftover temps. Absent destination and newly created directory policy are outside this fixture; it adds no ACL-stripping authority to the product. Local SDK kauth_ace is24bytes with flags at16 and rights at20; FILE_INHERIT bit5, INHERITED bit4, PERMIT kind1, READ_DATA bit1.

supplemental-access-and-reader-cases: ADR0340 existing restrictive permissions and access controls must not be relaxed; actual Darwin-only disposable-file ACL fixture uses /bin/chmod +a everyone deny execute and observes /bin/ls -lde ACE lines. No-op requires original inode/bytes/ACL. Changed save may preserve the ACL and literal expected payload or refuse guide.commit preserving original. A mode0400 control pins no permission escalation. Normal full-chunk reader checks that review failure does not prefetch following consent; former one-byte reader alone could mask buffering. Source-body oversize is guide.source, distinct from safe path selection. These fixtures specify real observable behavior; their existence is not execution evidence. Platform-specific ACL test skips only off Darwin, not on setup or assertion failure.

guide_test.go: ADR0340 protected API/stream/filesystem boundary; supplementary hand-authored source errors, actual symlink/hardlink paths, cooperative byte changes triggered after review begins, logical UTF-8 byte bounds, writer short/full-count errors and record-isolation probes. The static plan/preparation hardlink is a cross-kind alias refusal control, not a reaching proof of a valid output-alias guard: real decoders require incompatible kinds. ADR0200 requires each retained U+2028 to encode as six ASCII bytes: 180000 literal three-byte separators yield source below 1MiB but changed encoding above 1MiB, independent of product calculation. ADR0110 duplicate variables refuse; ADR0120 unaccepted organization default remains absent from guide. Missing plan ID cannot supply expected preparation identity. ADR0210 invalid resultsPath/account refuses without interaction.
